arxiv-2104-09741.title: A Shape Optimization Problem Constrained with the Stokes Equations to Address Maximization of Vortices Thanks: This work is supported by JSPS KAKENHI Grant Numbers JP18H01135, JP20H01823, JP20KK0058 and JP21H04431, and JST CREST Grant Number JPMJCR2014 for HN ; and by the Japanese Government (MEXT)
arxiv-2104-09741.description: Abstract . We study an optimization problem that aims to determine the shape of an obstacle that is submerged in a fluid governed by the Stokes equations. The mentioned flow takes place in a channel, which motivated the imposition of a Poiseuille-like input function on one end and a do-nothing boundary condition on the other.

arxiv-2105-10049.title: Learning Modular Robot Control Policies
arxiv-2105-10049.creator: Julian Whitman \affilnum 1, Matthew Travers \affilnum 2, and Howie Choset \affilnum 2
arxiv-2105-10049.description: Abstract Modular robots can be rearranged into a new design, perhaps each day, to handle a wide variety of tasks by forming a customized robot for each new task. However, reconfiguring just the mechanism is not sufficient: each design also requires its own unique control policy.

arxiv-2106-08731.title: EVA: a quantum Exponential Value Approximation algorithm
arxiv-2106-08731.creator: Guillermo Alonso-Linaje, Parfait Atchade-Adelomou
arxiv-2106-08731.description: Abstract VQE is currently one of the most widely used algorithms for optimizing problems using quantum computers. A necessary step in this algorithm is calculating the expectation value given a state, which is calculated by decomposing the Hamiltonian into Pauli operators and obtaining this value for each of them.

arxiv-2206-13105.title: Dark Matter perspective of Left-Right symmetric gauge model
arxiv-2206-13105.creator: Sanchari Bhattacharyya, Anindya Datta
arxiv-2206-13105.description: Abstract We consider an incarnation of left-right symmetric model with a local gauge symmetry of S ​ U ​ ( 3 ) C ⊗ S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) L ⊗ U ​ ( 1 ) L ⊗ S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) R ⊗ U ​ ( 1 ) R SU(3)_{C}\otimes SU(2)_{L}\otimes U(1)_{L}\otimes SU(2)_{R}\otimes U(1)_{R}

arxiv-2212-08443.title: Comment on ‘Comment on ‘Affine density, von Neumann dimension and a problem of Perelomov”
arxiv-2212-08443.creator: Luís Daniel Abreu
arxiv-2212-08443.description: Abstract . In the Letter ‘Comment on ‘Affine density, von Neumann dimension and a problem of Perelomov’ https://doi.org/10.48550/arXiv.2211.04879 , by Prof. J. L. Romero, it is claimed that the main theorem of Ref2 := [Adv. Math. 407, Article ID 108564, 22 p. (2022)] is included in the prior research survey Ref1 := [Expo. Math., 40(2), 265-301, 2022].

arxiv-2307-14423.title: Galactic properties that favour star cluster formation: a statistical view 2023 Galactic properties that favour star cluster formation: a statistical view – 3
arxiv-2307-14423.creator: Samantha C. Berek, Marta Reina-Campos, Gwendolyn Eadie, Alison Sills
arxiv-2307-14423.description: Abstract The presence or absence of star clusters in galaxies, and the properties of star cluster populations compared to their host galaxy properties, are important observables for validating models of cluster formation, galaxy formation, and galaxy assembly. In this work, we apply a Bayesian approach to fit two models to data from surveys of young clusters in star forming galaxies.

arxiv-2402-07300.title: SPICA: Interactive Video Content Exploration through Augmented Audio Descriptions for Blind or Low-Vision Viewers Conference: Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems; May 11–16, 2024; Honolulu, HI, USA Proceedings of the CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Sy
arxiv-2402-07300.creator: Zheng Ning, Brianna L. Wimer, Kaiwen Jiang, Keyi Chen, Jerrick Ban, Yapeng Tian, Yuhang Zhao, Toby Jia-Jun Li
arxiv-2402-07300.description: Abstract . Blind or Low-Vision (BLV) users often rely on audio descriptions (AD) to access video content. However, conventional static ADs can leave out detailed information in videos, impose a high mental load, neglect the diverse needs and preferences of BLV users, and lack immersion.

arxiv-2403-00270.title: Event-Driven Learning for Spiking Neural Networks
arxiv-2403-00270.creator: Wenjie Wei, Malu Zhang, Jilin Zhang, Ammar Belatreche, Jibin Wu, Zijing Xu, Xuerui Qiu, Hong Chen, Yang Yang and Haizhou Li
arxiv-2403-00270.description: Abstract Brain-inspired spiking neural networks (SNNs) have gained prominence in the field of neuromorphic computing owing to their low energy consumption during feedforward inference on neuromorphic hardware. However, it remains an open challenge how to effectively benefit from the sparse event-driven property of SNNs to minimize backpropagation learning costs.

arxiv-2406-00833.title: Harvard Undergraduate Survey on Generative AI
arxiv-2406-00833.creator: Shikoh Hirabayashi
arxiv-2406-00833.description: Abstract How has generative AI impacted the experiences of college students? We study the influence of AI on the study habits, class choices, and career prospects of Harvard undergraduates ( n = 326 n=326 ), finding that almost 90% of students use generative AI.

arxiv-2410-14503.title: Interplay of Tilt and Axion Fields in Topological Superconductors: Anisotropy in the Meissner Effect
arxiv-2410-14503.creator: Mojtaba Hassani, Zahra Faraei
arxiv-2410-14503.description: Abstract Topological superconductors host gapless surface states that fundamentally alter their electromagnetic response through the axion field term θ ​ 𝑬 ⋅ 𝑩 \theta\boldsymbol{E}\cdot\boldsymbol{B} , arising from the topological magnetoelectric effect. In this work, we investigate the electromagnetic properties of a three-dimensional topological Weyl superconductor by leveraging its theoretical mapping to a four-dimensional topological insulator with s-wave superconducting boundaries.

arxiv-2503-07616.title: An Alternate Method for Finding Particular Solutions of Nonhomegeneous Differential Equations
arxiv-2503-07616.creator: Ashot Djrbashian, Milena Safaryan
arxiv-2503-07616.description: Abstract . In this short note we are presenting a method of finding particular solutions of nonhomegeneous linear equations. This approach is different from methods of undetermined coefficients or variation of parameters presented in virtually every standard Differential Equations textbook. 1. Introduction Let (1) a_{n}y^{(n)}+a_{n-1}y^{(n-1)}+\cdots+a_{1}y^{\prime}+a_{0}y=q(t) be an n th order linear nonhomogeneous differential equation with constant coefficients.

arxiv-2510-05078.title: A Tauberian approach to metric scaling limits of random discrete structures, with an application to random planar maps
arxiv-2510-05078.creator: William FLEURAT
arxiv-2510-05078.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by William FLEURAT. We prove sandwich theorems and a Tauberian theorem in the space of compact metric measure spaces, endowed with the Gromov–Hausdorff–Prokhorov (GHP) topology. These results hold with respect to a close relative of Gromov’s Lipschitz order. As a proof-of-concept of a general method to prove metric scaling limits of random discrete structures, we give an application to the theory of random planar maps: the Brownian sphere is the scaling limit in the GHP topology of irreducible quandrangulations.

arxiv-2511-08090.title: StableMorph: High-Quality Face Morph Generation with Stable Diffusion
arxiv-2511-08090.creator: Wassim Kabbani, Kiran Raja, Raghavendra Ramachandra, Christoph Busch
arxiv-2511-08090.description: Abstract Face morphing attacks threaten the integrity of biometric identity systems by enabling multiple individuals to share a single identity. To develop and evaluate effective morphing attack detection (MAD) systems, we need access to high-quality, realistic morphed images that reflect the challenges posed in real-world scenarios.

arxiv-2602-09094.title: Downsizing does not extend to dwarf galaxies: identifying the stellar mass regimes shaped by supernova and AGN feedback 2026 Downsizing does not extend to dwarf galaxies: identifying the stellar mass regimes shaped by supernova and AGN feedback – 7
arxiv-2602-09094.creator: I. Lazar, S. Kaviraj, G. Martin, C. J. Conselice, S. Koudmani, A. E. Watkins, S. K. Yi, D. Kakkad, T. M. Sedgwick, Y. Dubois, J. E. G. Devriendt, K. Kraljic, S. Peirani
arxiv-2602-09094.description: Abstract We explore how the fraction of red (quenched) galaxies varies in the dwarf galaxy regime (10 7 M ⊙ < M ⋆ M_{\star} < 10 9.5 M ⊙ ), using a mass-complete sample of ∼ \sim 5900 dwarfs at z < 0.15 z<0.15 , constructed using deep multi-wavelength data in the COSMOS field.

plos-pone-0005388.creator: Emily J. Arnsdorf, Padmaja Tummala, Christopher R. Jacobs
plos-pone-0005388.description: PLOS ONE research article. Understanding how the mechanical microenvironment influences cell fate, and more importantly, by what molecular mechanisms, will enhance not only the knowledge of mesenchymal stem cell biology but also the field of regenerative medicine. pmc-10548119.title: Effects of biochar application and nutrient fluctuation on the growth, and cadmium and nutrient uptake of Trifolium repens with different planting densities in Cd-contaminated soils
pmc-10548119.creator: Wei-Long Zheng, Yan-Fei Wang, Jingya Mo, Pu Zeng, Jiayi Chen, Chenliang Sun
pmc-10548119.description: Biochar has been used to remediate contaminated-soil with heavy metals, however, less is known on how biochar interacts with planting density and nutrient fluctuation to affect the remediation. A pot experiment was conducted in the greenhouse to investigate the effects of biochar application (without vs. with 1% biochar, g/g substrate), nutrient fluctuation (constant vs.

pmc-10633866.title: Raman Spectroscopy for the Quantitative Analysis of Solid Dosage Forms of the Active Pharmaceutical Ingredient of Febuxostat
pmc-10633866.creator: Gull Rimsha, Muhammad Shahbaz, Muhammad Irfan Majeed, Haq Nawaz, Nosheen Rashid, Muhammad Waseem Akram, Ifra Shabbir, Kiran Kainat, Aiman Amir, Eiman Sultan, Mulja Munir, Muhammad Imran
pmc-10633866.description: Raman spectroscopy has been used to characterize and quantify the solid dosage forms of the commercially available drug febuxostat. For this purpose, different formulations consisting of the febuxostat (API) and excipients with different concentrations of the API are prepared and analyzed by Raman spectroscopy to identify different spectral features related to the febuxostat API and excipients.

pmc-11394250.title: The Association between the Severity of Distal Sensorimotor Polyneuropathy and Increased Carotid Atherosclerosis in Individuals with Type 2 Diabetes
pmc-11394250.creator: Dong-Yi Hsieh, Yun-Ru Lai, Chih-Cheng Huang, Chi-Ping Ting, Wen-Chan Chiu, Yung-Nien Chen, Chia-Yi Lien, Ben-Chung Cheng, Ting-Yin Lin, Hui Ching Chiang, Cheng-Hsien Lu
pmc-11394250.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Background: Diabetes contributes to a spectrum of complications encompassing microvascular and macrovascular disorders. This study aimed to explore the correlation between distal sensorimotor polyneuropathy (DSPN) severity and heightened carotid atherosclerosis among individuals with type 2 diabetes mellitus (T2DM). Method: Participants underwent comprehensive assessments including nerve conduction studies (NCS), Toronto Clinical Neuropathy Score (TCNS) evaluations, assessment of cardiometabolic risk factors, and carotid sonography studies covering dynamic and morphological parameters.

pmc-11511556.title: Synthesis of Polyacrylamide Nanomicrospheres Modified with a Reactive Carbamate Surfactant for Efficient Profile Control and Blocking
pmc-11511556.creator: Wenwen Yang, Xiaojuan Lai, Lei Wang, Huaqiang Shi, Haibin Li, Jiali Chen, Xin Wen, Yulong Li, Xiaojiang Song, Wenfei Wang
pmc-11511556.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). Urethane surfactants (REQ) were synthesized with octadecanol ethoxylate (AEO) and isocyanate methacrylate (IEM). Subsequently, reactive-carbamate-surfactant-modified nanomicrospheres (PER) were prepared via two-phase aqueous dispersion polymerization using acrylamide (AM), 2-acrylamido-2-methylpropanesulfonic acid (AMPS) and ethylene glycol dimethacrylate (EGDMA). The microstructures and properties of the nanomicrospheres were characterized and examined via infrared spectroscopy, nano-laser particle size analysis, scanning electron microscopy, and in-house simulated exfoliation experiments. The results showed that the synthesized PER nanomicrospheres had a uniform particle size distribution, with an average size of 336 nm.

pmc-12478229.title: Byline or Botline? The Dilemma of Artificial Intelligence in Medical Scholarship
pmc-12478229.creator: James Connor
pmc-12478229.description: g clinical schedules and the steep learning curve of operative independence. Into this high-stakes environment enters artificial intelligence (AI), with a suite of tools that promises to accelerate writing, synthesize literature, and streamline the often arduous process of academic authorship.

pmc-12659143.title: Key components of developing midwifery preceptors: a pathway to strengthen midwifery education and care in low resource settings
pmc-12659143.creator: Brittney J. van de Water, Julie Mann
pmc-12659143.description: Strengthening midwifery education and the quality of midwifery care is one of the most impactful interventions to address maternal and newborn morbidity and mortality. In this perspective, we describe nine key components that make for an effective preceptor program that should be kept to ensure high fidelity and to support quality outcomes.

pmc-12752347.title: Differential roles of coding and non-coding transcripts in obesity: insights from RNA-seq analysis of Macaca fascicularis hepatocytes
pmc-12752347.creator: Yu Liu, Ziting Wang, Linna Liu, Ya Tan, Wenling Zheng, Pengfei Zhang, Andrew P Hutchins, Leonard Lipovich, Weizhong Wang
pmc-12752347.description: Long non-coding RNAs (lncRNAs) can regulate metabolism-associated genes and cooperate to activate obesity-related pathways. However, the role of lncRNAs in obesity-related diabetes is not clear. To address this, we analyzed the hepatic transcriptomes of diabetic and non-diabetic Cynomolgus monkeys (Macaca fascicularis) using next-generation sequencing (NGS).

pmc-13363368.title: The Influence of Gender and Professional Background on the Accuracy of Visual Blood-Loss Estimation in Obstetrics—Prospective Observational Simulation Study
pmc-13363368.creator: Maximilian Niederer, Mathias Bader, Chiara Archam, Sascha Hammer, Sebastian Labenbacher, Helmar Bornemann-Cimenti, Lioba Heuschneider, Philipp Zoidl
pmc-13363368.description: Background/Objectives: Accurate visual estimation of blood loss during childbirth is critical for early recognition of obstetric hemorrhage, a leading cause of maternal morbidity and mortality. Despite its widespread use, visual estimation is prone to substantial bias. While professional experience has been shown to influence estimation accuracy, the potential contribution of gender differences remains insufficiently explored.

pmc-13420690.title: Percutaneous Vegetectomy for Severe Right-Sided Infective Endocarditis Complicated by Cardiac Arrest and Multiorgan Failure
pmc-13420690.creator: MHD Osama Srour, Haris Ahmed, Youssef Al-Saghir, Ahmed Zaky
pmc-13420690.description: BackgroundRight-sided infective endocarditis (RSIE) is a life-threatening condition predominantly affecting the tricuspid valve. For patients with prohibitive surgical risk, percutaneous vegetectomy (PV) is emerging as a viable alternative.Case SummaryA 38-year-old man with active intravenous drug use presented with cardiac arrest, profound shock, and multiorgan dysfunction. Echocardiography revealed a large tricuspid valve vegetation (2.0 × 3.1 cm) with severe regurgitation.

pmc-13427224.title: Enantioselective Synthesis of Axially Chiral Diaryl Ethers via Rhodium‐Catalyzed [2 + 2 + 2] Cycloaddition
pmc-13427224.creator: Yu Sato, Julong Jiang, Kairi Yamashiro, Ken Tanaka
pmc-13427224.description: Axially chiral diaryl ethers are important structural motifs in biologically active molecules, functional materials, and chiral catalysts. However, their enantioselective synthesis remains challenging because rotation around the Ar–O bond often occurs with relatively low rotational barriers, and most existing methods rely on desymmetrization strategies that inherently limit the accessible substitution patterns.

pmc-13514759.title: Association Between Body Mass Index and Physical Fitness Among University Students in a Sub-Plateau Region of Gansu Province, China: A Cross-Sectional Study
pmc-13514759.creator: Ming Chen, Linlin Zhao, Liting Yang, Mingxia Jin, Jiaqi Kong, Qin Yang

pmc-13600984.title: Impact of the volume-based procurement for intraocular lenses combined with the diagnosis-related group’s payment reform on hospitalization costs and expenditure structure among cataract patients: an interrupted time series analysis
pmc-13600984.creator: Lisha Zhou, Pengfei Zhou, Lin Shu, Kuanyu Xu, Qiang Lu, Feng Xiao, Haibo Liu, Xiaoguang Yang, Yunming Li
pmc-13600984.description: BackgroundCataract surgery is one of the most resource-intensive procedures in China, with intraocular lens (IOL) costs accounting for a substantial proportion of total hospitalization expenditure. To address persistently high prices of high-value medical consumables, our hospital implemented the Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei “3 + N” regional alliance procurement for IOLs in January 2022, followed by DRG payment reform in January 2024.

pmc-13631290.title: Coulombic surface dipole trapping ionomer for efficient proton exchange membrane fuel cells
pmc-13631290.creator: Siyuan Wang, Fanpeng Kong, Zhengyang Bao, Xiaozhi Zhao, Lei Zhang, Zhongxin Song, Junjie Li, Lei Du, Yongjun Xu, Bo Zhao, Geping Yin, Xueliang Sun
pmc-13631290.description: Uniform ionomer distribution and controlled sulfonate adsorption are critical for low-Pt-loading proton exchange membrane fuel-cell membrane electrode assemblies (MEAs), especially at high current density. In conventional Pt/C catalysts, differences between Pt and carbon surfaces promote sulfonate adsorption on Pt and ionomer aggregation on carbon, thereby limiting proton and oxygen transport.

pmc-13716474.title: Management of Adrenal Incidentalomas: A Survey of Physicians from the Middle East and Africa.
pmc-13716474.creator: Salem A Beshyah, Khadija Hafidh, Dima K Abdelmannan, Omar Dhaimat, Melika Chihaoui, Ian L Ross
pmc-13716474.description: Introduction: Adrenal incidentaloma (AI) is a common finding from increased imaging use. Several guidelines direct evaluation and management, but limited data exist on real-world practices.Aim: To describe the knowledge and practices of physicians from the Middle East and Africa (MEA) in AI.
